'''Kantis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. She was tasked with providing supplies to Imperial personnel during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
Stationed on the [[Vaiken Spacedock]] in between operations,<ref name="vaiken">{{TORcite|type=location|[[Vaiken Spacedock]]}}</ref> over the course of the [[Galactic War]] she was assigned to several worlds, following various campaigns of the conflict. [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeants]] [[Londar (Twi'lek)|Londar]] and [[Kidles (male)|Kidles]] served under her throughout the period, following the Major starting from Corellia, where all three were stationed at the [[Black Hole (Corellia)|Black Hole]] sector<ref name="black hole">{{TORcite|type=location|Black Hole|[[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]}}</ref> in the aftermath of the [[Battle of Corellia]] in late 3640 BBY.<ref name="Time-4">{{TOR_dates|4}}</ref>

Later they were joined by [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Kirius]] when Kantis was transferred to [[Section X]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], where they were stationed at the [[Crag Outpost]].<ref name="X">{{TORcite|type=location|Crag Outpost|[[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]}}</ref> Kirius stayed with the group and temporally replaced Sergeant Kidles on the next assignment, when Kantis was moved to [[Makeb]], during [[Darth Marr]]'s [[Conquest of Makeb|military campaign]] there.<ref name="makeb">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=location|[[Makeb]]}}</ref>

Kidles rejoined Major Kantis when during the [[Seizure of CZ-198]], she was stationed at the [[Imperial Landing Zone|Imperial zone]] of [[CZ-198]], with [[Imperial Ordnance Acquisition Corps]], under [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kresk]].<ref name="titans" /> Immediately after, she and her two sergeants joined a [[Dread Executioners|task force]] under Lord [[Hargrev]] sent to the [[moon]] [[Oricon]] during the [[Dread War]],<ref name="to oricon">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Imperial|Dread Masters Revealed|[[CZ-198]]}}</ref> where they were stationed at the [[Dread Executioners camp]].<ref name="oricon" /> Later reassigned to [[Darth Marr]], Kantis and her sergeants supplied his forces on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] during the [[Revanite crisis]],<ref name="yavin" /> after a brief shore leave on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]].<ref name="rishi">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=location|[[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]}}</ref>

In [[3636 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|3.2}}</ref> one of Kantis's Sergeants, [[Kidles (male)|Kidles]], was seen on the [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]] [[Ziost Analysis Services Center|orbital station]], treating the wounded who managed to escape from the planet's [[Invasion of Ziost|devastation]]. The fate of Major Kantis, whom he accompanied throughout the war, is unknown.<ref name="ziost">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=location|[[Ziost Analysis Services Center|Ziost Orbital Station]]}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Major Kantis appears ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a gear vendor on the Imperial Fleet and several planets.
